title: Glory Be to God the Father
description: Glory Be to God the Father in Tonic Solfa to ST. RAPHAEL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Horatius Bonar wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 268.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked 8.7.8.7.4.7, to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. RAPHAEL; any other 8.7.8.7.4.7 tune fits them as well.
underlay: Glo-ry be to God the Fa-ther, Glo-ry be to God the Son, Glo-ry be to God the Spir-it; Great Je-ho-vah, Three in One! Glo-ry, glo-ry, While e-ter-nal a-ges run!

lines: Glory be to God the Father,
Glory be to God the Son,
Glory be to God the Spirit;
Great Jehovah, Three in One!
Glory, glory,
While eternal ages run!
Glory be to Him who loved us,
Washed us from each spot and stain;
Glory be to Him who bought us,
Made us kings with Him to reign!
Glory, glory,
To the Lamb that once was slain!
Glory to the King of angels,
Glory to the Church’s King,
Glory to the King of nations;
Heaven and earth, your praises bring!
Glory, glory,
To the King of Glory bring!
Glory, blessing, praise eternal!
Thus the choir of angels sings;
Honor, riches, power, dominion!
Thus its praise creation brings;
Glory, glory,
Glory to the King of kings!

licence: Public domain: Horatius Bonar died in 1889.
credits: Words by Horatius Bonar (1808–1889), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to ST. RAPHAEL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
